headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Public Trend Signals
summary: Integrate real-time dependency analysis and risk assessment tools to improve the accuracy of ClearInstall's npm/PyPI install-time checks, especially focusing on binding.gyp command expansion. Leverage Rust-Anything for robustness in handling C/C++ bindings and Victory forks for enhanced security audits.
